_note: Events v4: across drowned, cathedral, iron, table and any, plus secrets. Ids prefixed v4e_. Story chains: v4e_corner -> v4e_closing_night -> v4e_asked_ninety -> secret Ninety; v4e_tommy_card -> v4e_wrote_back -> v4e_saw_tommy -> secret Back Seat; v4e_cook_key -> secret Cold Room. Some also follow v3 flags.

events.title: Lights Under the Water
events.text: Under the surface, a row of lit windows. A hall. Drowned. Somebody inside is still calling numbers.

check.pass_text: You touch the glass. Inside, a hand dabs a card. It slides a prize out through the letterbox.
check.fail_text: Cold. So cold. You come up slower than you went down.

check.pass_text: Ninety windows. One is dark. You remember which.
check.fail_text: You lose count. He does not. 'Eighty. Nine.'

events.title: Message in a Bottle
events.text: A pop bottle knocks against your boots. Inside: a bingo card, rolled tight. Crayon on the back.

options.label: Read it
options.result: COME HOME DAD. The letters are big. The cage behind you stops turning.

options.label: Keep it dry for later
options.result: You tuck it in your shirt. Something else was in the bottle. A card. A real one.

options.label: Throw it back
options.result: It bobs away. 'Thank. You.' He drops a coin on the map. For your trouble.

events.title: The Fare
events.text: The Ferryman holds out a palm. One coin a head. 'The water. Is rising. It does not. Do credit.'

options.label: Pay (30 gold)
options.result: You sit in the boat. Dry. Warm, almost. He rows like a man counting.

check.pass_text: You make the far bank. Your lungs are full of hall air.
check.fail_text: Something under you counts your legs.

options.label: Pay with a card
options.result: He takes a card from your hand without asking. Gives you something from the bottom of the boat.

events.title: The King Plays Too
events.text: The Drowned King has a bingo card. Your names are on it. Three are dabbed already. In weed.

options.label: Let him dab one

rows.text: He dabs. Somebody's leg goes cold and stays cold. He pays well.
He misses. 'Wet. Fingers.' He pays anyway.

options.result: 'House. Nearly.'

check.pass_text: You call your own numbers first. The King gapes. He pays you in crowns.
check.fail_text: He wins. He always wins. He writes a new rule in silt.

options.label: Refuse his card
options.result: 'Rude.' He sends someone large to teach manners.

events.title: Rising Seats
events.text: Folding chairs float up from the deep. Still in rows. Still facing the stage. One for each of you.

options.label: Sit
options.result: They hold you up. For a moment the water is carpet. Somebody passes a pen.

check.pass_text: You ride the rows across. Over things that were waiting.
check.fail_text: The chairs fold. On fingers. On everyone's.

events.title: Lifebelt
events.text: A lifebelt on a post. PROPERTY OF THE HALL. In the water, a shape in a cardigan, waving. Or drowning.

options.label: Keep the lifebelt
options.result: It fits round you. The waving stops.

check.pass_text: She climbs out. Dripping. 'Am I late? Is it eyes down?' She sits with you.
check.fail_text: She takes the belt. And your bag. And goes back down.

events.title: Tannoy Under Water
events.text: A loudspeaker on a drowned lamppost. Bubbles. A voice. 'Kelly's. Eye. Number. One.' It is him. Younger.

check.pass_text: Between the numbers, a cough. A tell. You learn it.
check.fail_text: The numbers get into your ears. They stay there.

options.label: Shout back
options.result: 'BINGO!' The speaker stops. Above you, the real one turns very slowly.

events.title: Eel Raffle
events.text: A bucket of eels. Each wears a cloakroom tag. A sign: ONE GO. NO REFUNDS. NO FINGERS.

options.label: Reach in

rows.text: A tag. Number nine. A purse comes with it.
A card, folded in an eel's mouth.

options.result: Cold. Moving. Counting.

options.label: Feed them (15 gold)
options.result: They eat the coins. Down the river, everything else goes hungry.

events.title: Hymn Board
events.text: The hymn board reads 7. 11. 88. No hymns have those numbers. The choir hums them anyway.

check.pass_text: Lucky seven. Legs eleven. Two fat ladies. The stone sings with you.
check.fail_text: You get one wrong. The whole church turns round.

check.pass_text: You slide in 90. Something in the rules unclicks.
check.fail_text: The board is hot. The numbers were not for you.

events.title: Confession Card
events.text: A card in the booth. Two columns. SINS. NUMBERS. A stub of pencil on a chain.

options.label: Confess the cheating
options.result: Every palmed die. Every look away. The grille sighs. Penance is in the knuckles.

options.label: Confess nothing
options.result: Blank. The confessor slides back a coin. 'Keep it. You will need. Lawyers.'

check.pass_text: You write: HE NEVER CALLED IT. A long silence. Then. 'Yes.'
check.fail_text: 'You do not. Know. My sins.' He underlines your name.

events.title: Relic Raffle
events.text: A trestle table. Finger bones in jam jars, raffle tickets taped on. TOMBOLA FOR THE ROOF.

options.label: Buy a ticket (30 gold)
options.result: Pink. Number 30. You win a jar. It taps from inside.

check.pass_text: Under your coat. Nobody saw. He saw.
check.fail_text: The deacon takes your hand. Gently. Then counts your fingers.

events.title: Font of Tea
events.text: The font is full of stewed tea. Milk, two sugars. Still warm. Somebody blessed it.

options.label: Drink
options.result: Holy. Heavy. Everybody needs a sit-down after.

options.label: Bathe a wound
options.result: It scalds. Then it stops hurting. Then it stops everything.

events.title: Carved Stalls
events.text: Names carved into the choir stalls. LINDA. JANET. STEVE. PAULINE. One is fresh. Yours.

check.pass_text: Gone. You feel lighter. Like somebody who could leave.
check.fail_text: The wood grows back. Your name is deeper now.

check.pass_text: You do not know his name. Your hand does. One rule goes quiet.
check.fail_text: Your knife will not write it. The cage spins very fast.

events.title: The Saint's Biscuit Tin
events.text: The Saint holds out a tin. Shortbread. A tooth among the biscuits. 'Take one. Only one.'

options.label: Take a biscuit
options.result: Butter. Sugar. You share it four ways. It goes further than it should.

options.label: Take the tooth
options.result: Warm. Not hers. She smiles without it.

events.title: Bell Rope
events.text: A rope from the belfry. The bell does not ring. It calls. 'Two. And. Four.'

check.pass_text: The bell calls numbers nobody has. Things below lose their place.
check.fail_text: It calls yours. Your ears ring for a page.

check.pass_text: From the belfry, you see the whole map. And coins in the gutter.
check.fail_text: Halfway. Then not.

events.title: A Wedding Photo
events.text: On the altar, a framed photo. A young man with a face. A woman in white. A hall behind them. The cage turns away.

check.pass_text: It is this hall. Ribbon on seat zero. A boy in a too-big suit. Holding the bingo cage.
check.fail_text: 'No. No. That. Is private.'

options.label: Turn it face down
options.result: 'Thank. You.' Very quiet. 'She. Liked. The hall.'

options.label: Pocket it
options.result: He does not say anything. He sends someone to say it.

events.title: The Cook's Keys
events.text: A hook by the furnace. A ring of keys. A paper tag in capitals: COLD ROOM. DO NOT.

options.label: Take them
options.result: Heavy. Cold even here. Something in the cellar stops humming.

check.pass_text: Off the hook. Not a jingle. A coin was taped to the tag.
check.fail_text: They jingle. Every head on the line turns.

events.title: Pay Packet
events.text: A brown envelope with your name typed on it. Inside, dice and an IOU. Signed with a number.

options.label: Open it
options.result: Wages. For work you have not done. Yet.

options.label: Hand it back unopened
options.result: 'Honest.' He sounds surprised. 'They. Used. To be.'

options.label: Swap it for Linda's
options.result: Her packet. Thick. Never collected. She would want it spent.

events.title: The Conveyor
events.text: Numbered balls ride the belt into the furnace. Each one pops. Each pop, someone at the table flinches.

check.pass_text: Number thirteen. Unlucky for some. Inside it: cards.
check.fail_text: Hot. You keep it too long.

check.pass_text: It grinds. It stops. Down the line, the furnace starves.
check.fail_text: The belt does not stop. Your arm almost goes in.

options.label: Let them burn
options.result: Pop. Pop. Pop. You stop flinching. That is worse.

events.title: Union Meeting
events.text: The miners vote by show of hands. Dice in every fist. 'Strike. Or work.'

options.label: Vote to strike
options.result: Down tools. One rule goes with them. The foreman sends a deputy.

options.label: Vote to work
options.result: Another shift. Everyone's back is worse. The pay is real.

events.title: Canteen
events.text: Steak pie. Chips. Tea in a mug that says WORLD'S BEST NAN. A raffle ticket under the plate.

options.label: Eat
options.result: Hot food. Real food. Nobody talks. Nobody needs to.

options.label: Take the ticket
options.result: Your number. Your prize. He brings it out on a plate.

events.title: Safety Board
events.text: DAYS WITHOUT AN ACCIDENT: 0. The 0 is painted on. It has been 0 for forty years.

check.pass_text: You chalk a 1. One day. The shift walks more carefully.
check.fail_text: An accident. Right on cue.

options.label: Add to the count
options.result: Somebody has to keep it honest. Somebody does.

events.title: The Whistle
events.text: The foreman's whistle, on a lanyard. Blow it, and the shift starts. Whoever is near.

options.label: Blow it
options.result: The shift starts. You are what's near.

options.label: Hide it
options.result: In your sock. He is checking pockets now.

options.label: Give it to him
options.result: 'Good. Worker.' He blows it. Somewhere else.

events.title: Lamp Room
events.text: A rack of miners' lamps. A brass tag on each. Every tag has a name. One is blank.

options.label: Take a lamp
options.result: Somebody's. They will not be needing it. Their tag swings.

options.label: Write your name on the blank
options.result: Now you have a lamp. Now you work here.

events.title: Last Orders Bell
events.text: At the edge of the map, a brass bell. The bar's. Ring it, and the night ends. That is what it is for.

check.pass_text: Ding. Every regular looks up. Then, slowly, back down. The night goes on.
check.fail_text: He puts a glove over it. 'No. No. Not. Last orders.'

options.label: Stuff the bell with napkins
options.result: Quiet. Good. He brings round crisps.

events.title: The Ashtray
events.text: A heavy glass ashtray. Full of dice, not ends. Each one has the burn of a cigarette on the six.

options.label: Palm a die
options.result: It rolls the way you want. Mostly. It smells of the seventies.

options.label: Empty it
options.result: Dice and coins. Old money. He never cleaned that ashtray. Nobody was allowed.

events.title: His Pencil
events.text: His pencil. Chewed. He has no teeth. On the map margin, in its grey: notes about you.

check.pass_text: You write a rule of your own. It is smaller than his. It counts.
check.fail_text: He rubs it out. With his thumb. With you.

options.label: Snap it
options.result: Snap. Inside the lead: a little gold. Outside: a big problem.

options.label: Give it back
options.result: He takes it. 'Th. Thank you.' He writes something nicer.

events.title: Your Miniature
events.text: A miniature of you. Painted badly. Lovingly. The eyes are two dots. The dots follow you.

check.pass_text: Better eyes. Steadier hands. You feel more there.
check.fail_text: You smudge the leg. Your leg agrees.

options.label: Turn it to face the door
options.result: It faces the exit now. He turns it back. Then again. Then lets it.

events.title: Crisps
events.text: A packet of crisps. Prawn cocktail. Best before 1986. Inside, under the crisps, a card.

options.label: Share the crisps
options.result: Stale. Pink. Every bit as good as you remember. Not quite as safe.

options.label: Take the card
options.result: Greasy. Valid. 'Prizes. Are prizes.'

events.title: The Chair Beside Him
events.text: There is a chair beside him on the stage. Dust on the seat. A coat over the back. A child's.

check.pass_text: He does not look. He moves his arm. Like for someone small.
check.fail_text: 'That. Is. Taken.'

options.label: Wipe the dust off
options.result: Clean. He stares at it a long time. 'He. Will be. Back.'

events.title: Page 42
events.text: The rulebook. Page 41 is torn out. Derek's. Page 42 is still here. It is very long.

check.pass_text: A loophole. Plain as day. He forgot to tear this one.
check.fail_text: Page 42 is a rule. You read it. Now it applies.

options.label: Tear it out
options.result: For Derek. He feels it go. The whole book flinches.

events.title: The Chalkboard
events.text: A chalk scoreboard. Every party that ever sat here. Columns of tallies. Yours has none.

check.pass_text: One stroke. It counts. The house pays out.
check.fail_text: The chalk squeaks. Everyone hears.

options.label: Rub out the others
options.result: Decades of names. Gone. The dust gets in your lungs. It has opinions.

events.title: The Bottom Corner
events.text: The flashboard hangs over the map. Every bulb has lit. Except the bottom corner. 88. 89. 90.

check.pass_text: The bulb is fine. Dusted. Polished. He has never once called it.
check.fail_text: You look too long. 'Eyes. Down.'

options.label: Ask why
options.result: He takes a long time. Then he answers.

events.title: Closing Night
events.text: A poster under the map, yellow at the corners. LAST GAME. FRIDAY. HALL CLOSES FOR GOOD. THANK YOU ALL.

options.label: Read it out
options.result: He listens. 'Last. Game. Yes. If someone wins. It ends. So.' He does not finish.

options.label: Fold it away
options.result: 'Thank. You. Nobody. Needs. That.' But you have read it now.

options.label: Tear it up
options.result: The date tears in half. He does not stop you. A rule goes with it.

events.title: The Last Ball
events.text: He holds a ball up to the light. 90. Worn smooth from holding. 'Every Friday. I take it out. I put it. Back.'

check.pass_text: 'If I call it. Pauline wins. Everyone. Gets their coat. The lights. Go off. And I. Am. Nothing.' He puts it back.
check.fail_text: 'NO.' The cage locks. Then, quieter. 'No. Not. Tonight.'

options.label: Tell him he can keep it
options.result: 'Thank. You.' The whole hall relaxes. Nobody should have.

options.label: Grab for it
options.result: Gloves. Fast. You will not try that twice.

events.title: Writing Back
events.text: He has found the card. COME HOME DAD. He holds out his pencil. 'I cannot. Write. Small. Will you?'

options.label: Write: SOON
options.result: He dictates the rest. NOT YET. EAT YOUR TEA. DAD. He folds it twice.

options.label: Write: NEVER
options.result: He reads it. He reads it again. Every piece on the board stands up straighter.

options.label: Refuse
options.result: 'No. No. Of course.' He tucks the pencil away. He tries. He cannot.

events.title: Headlights
events.text: Light across the map. Car headlights, through the hall door. Engine running. They have been running since closing night.

check.pass_text: A boy in the back seat. Seven. Old eyes. He has your note. 'Is he coming?' You don't know what to say.
check.fail_text: The door is on the board. You end up back at the table.

options.label: Wave
options.result: The lights blink. Twice. Someone in the car waves back.

options.label: Tell him who is outside
options.result: The dice are cold for a while. So is he.

events.title: Show of Hands
events.text: 'Hands up. Who. Wants to go home.' The regulars at the back do not move. Not one hand. Not in forty years.

options.label: Raise your hand
options.result: Yours is the only hand. He counts it. He writes it down. He does not open the door.

options.label: Ask the regulars why

effects.text: 'Home. Is a room. With nobody in it. Here. There is. Always. Another number.'

options.result: A woman in a coat answers. Not him. He lets her.

options.label: Keep your hands on the table
options.result: 'Good. Good. Everyone. Stays.' That is the answer he always gets.

events.title: The Handbag, Again
events.text: Linda's handbag is on your chair. She must have put it there. She has not moved. Not since 1986.

options.label: Open it
options.result: A lipstick. A photo of a cat. Something that hums.

options.label: Take it back to her
options.result: You put it on her lap. Under the sheet, her hands close round it. Your bruises fade.

events.title: The Other Wellington
events.text: The other boot. Size eleven. STEVE in biro. Full of dice. All of them are sixes now.

options.label: Pour them out
options.result: Sixes. All sixes. 'He. Would have. Laughed.'

options.label: Keep one
options.result: It only rolls six. That is not a die. That is a liability.

events.title: Janet's Cardigan
events.text: The seat you saved has a cardigan on it now. And a dauber. And two dice, tucked deep in a sleeve.

options.label: Take the dice
options.result: Hers. She would want them used. Against him.

options.label: Leave her things
options.result: She is somewhere close. You can tell from the smell of mints.

options.label: Wear the cardigan
options.result: Deep sleeves. He watches your sleeves now.

events.title: A Dauber
events.text: A bingo dauber on the map. Red. Still wet. Somebody dropped it mid-game.

options.label: Dab yourself
options.result: A red dot on the back of your hand. Counted. Kept.

options.label: Dab the map
options.result: Red on the paper. A room that wasn't there.

events.title: The Cold Room
events.text: The Cook's key fits. Frost. Hooks. Coats on the hooks. Staff on crates, playing cards. Dave. Margaret. Maureen. A fourth crate, empty. They look up.

options.label: Deal yourself in
options.result: Margaret deals. 'Tommy's crate,' says Maureen. 'He goes out to sit in the car. He always comes back.' Your fingers do not warm up again.

options.label: Let them out
options.result: They walk past you. Into the hall. Into seats. They sit down. They do not leave either.

options.label: Take their tips jar
options.result: Stock in. Never out. The Cook will be wanting that back.

events.title: Ninety
events.text: The cage door is open. The ball is on the felt. 90. Top of the shop. He is not looking. He is letting you.

check.pass_text: 'Ninety.' Pauline stands. Every coat in the hall rustles. A car engine starts. Then he takes the ball back. 'Not. Yet. Soon.'
check.fail_text: Your mouth will not make the word. His makes it for you. Backwards.

options.label: Give it to Pauline
options.result: She holds it. She does not dab. 'Not without him calling it, love.' She gives you something for the trouble.

options.label: Put it back
options.result: You close the door on it. 'Thank. You.' He means it. That is the worst part.

events.title: The Back Seat
events.text: The car. Engine running. A boy of seven, or a man of fifty. It depends when you look. He holds the cage handle. Just the handle.

options.label: Ask what happened

effects.text: 'I was to hold it. Till it stopped. It didn't stop. So I let go. And Dad. Got in.'

options.result: He tells you. Slowly. Like numbers.

options.label: Give him your seat at the table
options.result: Somebody gets out of the car. Somebody sits with you. The engine keeps running.

options.label: Tell him to go home
options.result: 'Not without Dad.' He turns the headlights off. For a page, the hall is dark and kind.

events.title: Brenda's Car
events.text: Her keys fit a car under the map. A little plastic house on the fob. Child seats in the back. Empty. Waiting.

options.label: Start it
options.result: It starts first time. The radio plays the numbers. You can't drive out. You drive round.

options.label: Leave the keys in it
options.result: For her. For when. 'She. Had to. Get home.' He sounds like he understands.

options.label: Search the glovebox
options.result: Parking tickets. Barley sugars. Change for the meter.

events.title: The Projection Booth
events.text: A room above the hall. A projector, still warm. Home movies on the reel. A Friday. A party. A man with a face, calling numbers. Badly.

options.label: Watch it through
options.result: He laughs on screen. He drops the balls. The regulars clap anyway. That was when they stayed because they wanted to.

options.label: Splice yourself in
options.result: Now you were there. Now you know how he looked away.

options.label: Burn the reel
options.result: Nitrate. Fast. Below you, he stops mid-number. He does not finish it.
